## Theses and internships

Looking for a master's thesis or internship? Send us an email with your CV and we will get back to you.

```{=html}
<p class="contact-actions">
<button type="button" id="contact-email" class="contact-button"><i class="bi bi-envelope-fill"></i> Email us</button>
<button type="button" id="contact-copy" class="contact-button"><i class="bi bi-clipboard"></i> Copy our email address</button>
</p>
<p id="contact-status" class="contact-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
<noscript>Please turn on JavaScript to use these buttons, or find us on LinkedIn above.</noscript>
<script>
// Our address is never written on the page. It is put together only when someone
// clicks a button, and then it goes straight to their email app or clipboard.
// Programs that collect addresses from websites do not click buttons.
(function () {
  function address() { return "demonlab.lund" + "@" + "gmail.com"; }
  var status = document.getElementById("contact-status");

  document.getElementById("contact-email").addEventListener("click", function () {
    window.location.href = "mailto:" + address() + "?subject=" +
      encodeURIComponent("Master's thesis or internship application");
    status.textContent = "If your email app did not open, use the copy button and paste the address into your email.";
  });

  document.getElementById("contact-copy").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var failed = "Sorry, we could not copy it. Please try the Email us button.";
    var copied = "Copied! Paste it into your email.";

    // older way of copying, for browsers that refuse the modern one
    function copyOldWay() {
      var box = document.createElement("textarea");
      box.value = address();
      box.setAttribute("readonly", "");
      box.style.position = "fixed";
      box.style.opacity = "0";
      document.body.appendChild(box);
      box.select();
      var ok = false;
      try { ok = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch (err) { ok = false; }
      document.body.removeChild(box);
      status.textContent = ok ? copied : failed;
    }

    if (!navigator.clipboard || !navigator.clipboard.writeText) { copyOldWay(); return; }
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(address()).then(
      function () { status.textContent = copied; }, copyOldWay);
  });
})();
</script>
```

In your email, please tell us:

- your name, university and degree level,
- what you would like to apply for (for example a master's thesis or an internship),
- when you would like to start and for how long,
- a few lines about your interests, with your CV attached as a PDF.

For PhD and postdoc positions, please apply through our [Openings](news.html#openings) page. Thank you!
